description.text:
Charm (魅) is one of the two booster packs of Brave Stars, alongside Courage (勇). Brave Stars (勇魅群星) was the fifth Sword & Shield booster release in Simplified Chinese, on sale from 18 June 2024 in 5- and 25-card packs. It brought Pokémon VSTAR, which evolve from Pokémon V and carry a VSTAR Power, an Ability or attack so strong that a player can use only one in a game, and give up two Prize cards when Knocked Out. It also brought Radiant Pokémon, Basic Pokémon with the rarity mark K and strong attacks or Abilities, of which a deck may hold only one, and two new rarities of full-art cards in each artist's own style: Art Rare (AR) and Special Art Rare (SAR).

Charm's headline cards are Hisuian Typhlosion V and VSTAR, and the Charm sleeves and binder carry Hisuian Typhlosion. It also has Arceus VSTAR, whose Ability takes any two cards from the deck, Charizard V and VSTAR, Mewtwo V and VSTAR and Hisuian Samurott V and VSTAR; the Radiant Pokémon Heatran, Gardevoir, Hisuian Sneasler and Eevee; and Art Rares of Lunatone, Solrock and Bibarel. Its main cards are numbered out of 127; Art Rare, full-art, Special Art Rare, rainbow and gold cards are numbered past it, up to 176.
